edges.reason: _transferFrom reads and mutates sender and recipient balances.
transferFrom reads and decrements the caller allowance.
_transferFrom path is reachable from allowance-based transfers.
isFeeExempt determines whether takeFee is applied to a sender.
lastBuy compared against block.timestamp and sellPeriod to set the high-fee period.
lastSell compared against block.timestamp and antiDumpPeriod to reset impact.
lastSellAmount accumulates impact estimates used to trigger the anti-dump tax.
totalFee is multiplied with the amount to compute feeAmount.
feeDenominator divides the computed fee amount.
antiDumpTax scales the fee on qualifying sells.
liquidityPools determines buy/sell direction and anti-dump applicability.
sellPercent multiplies totalFee during the high-sell period.
antiDumpPeriod window is evaluated against block.timestamp.
takeFee credits the staking receiver balance share.
takeFee credits the contract balance with the retained fee.
_transferFrom invokes takeFee when fees apply.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transferFrom.
transfer delegates execution to _transferFrom.
_transferFrom can trigger swapBack which performs external calls before balance finalization.
_transferFrom calls out to the anti-snipe contract before completing state updates.
antisnipe address determines the external callback target.
protectionEnabled gates the anti-snipe callback in _transferFrom.
launchedAt gates trading restrictions in _transferFrom.
_maxTxAmount is enforced by checkTxLimit inside _transferFrom.
_maxWalletSize is enforced by checkWalletLimit inside _transferFrom.
liquidityProviders permits transfers before launch.
inSwap short-circuits to _basicTransfer.
swapEnabled gates the swap-back condition.
swapThreshold caps amountToSwap in swapBack.
swapMinimum gates whether swapBack executes.
router instance is the target of the swap and liquidity calls.
swapBack performs external router calls that yield control to third parties.
swapBack forwards marketing and dev ETH through transferToAddressETH.
transferToAddressETH performs a low-level value call to an arbitrary address.
Marketing receiver receives ETH through the low-level call.
Dev receiver receives ETH through the low-level call.
targetLiquidity determines dynamicLiquidityFee in swapBack.
pair reserves are read for the anti-dump impact estimate.
